issues.rationale: A failed new confirmation could fall back to a valid password intent cookie left by another user on a shared browser.
issues.fix: Clear any existing password intent before every confirmation branch and only set a new cookie after successful atomic issuance.
issues.disposition_reason: 950fb06 clears the old intent before Origin and OTP handling and tests OTP, identity, RPC, and cross-origin failures.

issues.rationale: Editing a linked staff email can diverge from Auth and user_profiles and prevent recovery.
issues.fix: Make linked email immutable or add a compensated coordinated email-change flow.
issues.disposition_reason: Existing GitHub Issue #16 tracks the coordinated linked-email workflow; Round 3 permits non-blocking Should backlog.

issues.rationale: Security-sensitive audit insert errors are not surfaced to the caller.
issues.fix: Fail closed or persist a retryable partial-success audit state.
issues.disposition_reason: Existing GitHub Issue #16 tracks audit failure handling; it is outside the Round 3 Must remediation.

issues.rationale: The first PostgreSQL test only exercised staff RLS and did not populate every policy changed by the migration.
issues.fix: Populate two organizations and assert row isolation for all changed RLS policy groups.
issues.disposition_reason: 950fb06 adds two-organization rows and assertions for attendance records, events, requests, shifts, submissions, items, and notifications.

issues.rationale: The cross-origin regression asserts old-cookie clearing and early OTP rejection but does not explicitly assert that the new-cookie setter was not called.
issues.fix: Add an explicit not-to-have-been-called assertion for setStaffPasswordIntentCookie.
issues.disposition_reason: POSTCAP-001: implementation returns before token generation and setter access; retained as a non-blocking Round 3 test-clarity follow-up without opening another review round.

issues.rationale: Invite and reset result messages do not expose status or alert semantics to assistive technology.
issues.fix: Use role=status for success and role=alert for failure.
issues.disposition_reason: Existing GitHub Issue #16 tracks this accessibility follow-up.
